items.title: Sid Davilla Interview, 1969-04-17
items.q: We put a band together for Kid Howard and Kid was here for a while.

ctx.x: And what have you been playing most nights a week?

Six nights a week. Six nights a week. When he came in as a steady band, you see. And opposed to George, we had Lizzie Miles whom we resurrected. And Lizzie would do, along with Joe Robichaud, she would do the low, you know, the 15 minutes. And of course we went through many, many wonderful people like Kid Howard. We put a band together for Kid Howard and Kid was here for a while. About that time his chops came out and he had to take a respite from it. We were probably using it.
